g.text: C1 zoom · minivllm throughput -4.77% vs oMLX
minivllm vs oMLX vs Lithos: measured engine frontiers
M5 Ultra · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · 512 output tokens/request · HTTP C1 and C8 · 3 fresh processes/group
minivllm frontier: C1 = graph + GDN; C8 = E024 graph. Each endpoint is a measured executable configuration.
Lines connect measured endpoints only. C2–7 are unmeasured. HTTP concurrency C does not mean GPU batch size.
Horizontal axis is full-request speed, not P90 token interactivity or ITL. Vertical axis is throughput, not tokens per dollar.
Zoom whiskers show process min–max, not confidence intervals. Lithos C8 uses its measured FIFO service; full value is on the main chart.
